title: Anchor Corporation
text: A powerhouse in the overseas shipping industry, owning most of the harbour district. Run by Lord Addelard Nelson, an Illithid who keeps the business on schedule through a hivemind of hired mindflayer security.

title: Volcron Industries
text: Built an empire on architecture and magical machinery. Now a central location for factories and assembly lines, run by the feared Baron Maximilian Faust.
